questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of research as described in the chapter?

options.text: To randomly search for information on the internet without a plan
To ask questions and hunt for answers in a structured, curious way
To copy information directly from books for school projects
To avoid asking questions and rely only on personal opinions

correct_answer.text: To ask questions and hunt for answers in a structured, curious way

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of primary research according to the chapter?

options.text: Reading an article on the history of the Indian Freedom Struggle on IndiaHistory.com
Watching a YouTube documentary about gaming trends in India
Surveying 15 classmates about their stress levels before exams using a Google Form
Checking NCERT.org for timelines of historical events

correct_answer.text: Surveying 15 classmates about their stress levels before exams using a Google Form

questions.question_text: How can research skills help in everyday life decisions as mentioned in the chapter?

options.text: By helping you guess the best option without any data
By enabling you to compare prices and reviews before buying a phone worth ₹20,000 (approx. $240)
By ensuring you always agree with your friends’ opinions
By avoiding the need to check facts or information

correct_answer.text: By enabling you to compare prices and reviews before buying a phone worth ₹20,000 (approx. $240)
